title: Codec gate wire mapping
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with Boolean alphabet, let $n,s$ be natural numbers, let $p$ specify an input-head position and a work-head position for each work tape, let $q$ be a codec case, and let $b$ be a codec bit. The gate-wire map assigns each port a Boolean flag and a codec bit: the state, input-head, input-symbol, work-head, work-symbol, and summary ports all have flag false and carry, respectively, the corresponding state bit, head bit, input-wire bit, work-head bit, work-symbol bit (using index $1$ for true and $0$ for false), or summary bit. The old-bit port has flag false and carries $b$, while the new-bit port has flag true and carries $b$.
